title.suggested: Advertisement for Tom Allen's Free and Easy

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch carried a notice calling Tom Allen's Free and Easy at 417 Washington Avenue the best and coolest place of amusement in the city, with the champion keeping order.

metadata.notes: 1874-11-14 is before the Post-Dispatch existed (1878-12). The clipping begins with an unrelated Harper's Magazine notice.

facts.fact: Allen ran the Free and Easy at 417 Washington Avenue, St. Louis; a notice said latest songs were sung every night and the champion kept order
